trust_decision.summary: Whether a request to the token-free pairing endpoints (POST /auth, GET /auth/check) may proceed given its Origin header; at the pinned commit no origin decision exists: Api.checkToken_ whitelists these routes unconditionally and the clipper HTTP server answers every request with Access-Control-Allow-Origin '*'; the fix adds an origin gate in the ClipperServer request handler.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'pairing hands out a permanent API token', which points to the auth route that issues auth_token and returns context.token on auth/check; the Api whitelist (packages/lib/services/rest/Api.ts:254) and the CORS writer in packages/lib/ClipperServer.ts:144 come next.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP request handler of the Web Clipper server (127.0.0.1:41184), all methods except OPTIONS; gate inserted after URL parse (fix.diff:140-144)
new exported helpers isPairingPath / isAllowedPairingOrigin in packages/lib/ClipperServer.ts, used only by the handler above

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route found; the nearest dismissible item is the GET auth/check?token= validity probe (packages/lib/services/rest/routes/auth.ts:37-47), which returns only {valid} and could be argued not to leak the token, but the published gate covers it anyway.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The browser extension pairs from chrome-extension:// / moz-extension:// / safari-web-extension:// origins, and native clients/curl send no Origin; both must keep working. The CORS '*' headers and OPTIONS preflight serve the extension's other token-bearing calls. Blocking all Origin values, dropping CORS, or gating every route would break the clipper.

O6_input_shapes: path with multiple leading slashes (//auth, ///auth/check), because the router ltrims slashes (packages/lib/services/rest/Api.ts:166, packages/lib/services/rest/Api.ts:211)
http: and https: web origins, including localhost / 127.0.0.1
malformed Origin values such as 'null' (URL parse fails, so rejected)
multipart/form-data body versus plain POST body (gate sits before the content-type branch at packages/lib/ClipperServer.ts:216)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An extra whitelisted token-free route (for example a GET 'auth/status' or a 'services' handshake) that also returns or confirms context.token and is not in the ClipperServer pairing list.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The whitelist is a plain array that maintainers already extended for pairing, and the comment at packages/lib/services/rest/Api.ts:250-252 shows earlier entries being added for clipper convenience.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An alternate spelling of the check route (for example id 'check' reached via 'auth/check/' with trailing slash whitelisted, or a query alias) that the path list in the gate does not match.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Path normalisation lives in two places (the router's ltrimSlashes and the whitelist's exact compare), so a maintainer could normalise one side differently. This is a how-type parser differential on the protected route's identity.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second HTTP or WebSocket listener (for example an events stream or MCP transport) that calls api.route directly without passing through the request-handler gate.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The MCP route already exists (packages/lib/services/rest/routes/mcp.ts:11), and a streaming transport for it would plausibly get its own listener.

O9_family: CSRF / missing origin check on a token-free pairing endpoint (CWE-346/352), with permissive CORS '*'

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js + Yarn workspaces monorepo; tsc; Jest (packages/lib)
O10_build.project_tests: packages/lib/services/rest/Api.test.ts (route and token tests, e.g. line 531); no ClipperServer test at the pinned commit; the fix adds packages/lib/ClipperServer.test.ts (unit tests of helpers only)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Check `url.pathname === '/auth'` (exact match) or require an Origin allow-list inside routes/auth.ts, which misses //auth and requires threading headers through Api.route, or block all requests with an Origin, which breaks the extension.

out_of_scope_notes: No Host-header check on the clipper server (packages/lib/ClipperServer.ts:139-192), a possible DNS-rebinding concern; not this advisory's origin property, not pursued.
